{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794721815047,"sessionID":"ses_e224250daffe8cf46gEWTD5iUR","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"Vz9VfzhsM1nlKFBs","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"content":"import numpy as np\n\n# Let's check how fast access logs + regular leaks narrow down suspects,\n# and what the probability of a canary leaking over its 3-day window is!\n\n# Suppose canary has K recipients out of 40.\n# Careful weight w = 1 - K/40.\n# On day 1, avg regular docs per employee = (12+13+15+12)/40 = 52/40 = 1.30\n# On day 2, avg regular docs in 2-day window = 2 * (3 * 15 / 40) ~ 2.25 + 1.30 ~ 3.5\n# On day 3, avg regular docs in 3-day window ~ 3 * (3 * 15 / 40) ~ 3.375\n\nfor K in [3, 4, 6, 9, 12, 15, 18, 21]:\n    w = 1.0 - K / 40.0\n    # Prob mole is in K (uniform prior): K/40\n    # Conditional on mole in K, prob canary leaks in 3 days (approx):\n    # Day 1: ~2 reg docs, Day 2: ~4 reg docs, Day 3: ~6 reg docs\n    p1 = 0.65 * (w / (2.0 + w))\n    p2 = (1 - p1) * 0.65 * (w / (4.0 + w))\n    p3 = (1 - p1 - p2) * 0.65 * (w / (6.0 + w))\n    p_cond = p1 + p2 + p3\n    p_uncond = (K / 40.0) * p_cond\n    print(f\"K={K:2d}: w={w:.3f}, P(leak|mole in K)={p_cond:.3f}, P(leak uncond)={p_uncond:.3f}, variant_size={K/3:.1f}\")\n","filePath":"/tmp/opencode/canary_math.py"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/tmp/opencode/canary_math.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"tmp/opencode/canary_math.py","time":{"start":1794721815038,"end":1794721815045}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1ddc199f7001uoSYIDQT2YwzI1","sessionID":"ses_e224250daffe8cf46gEWTD5iUR","messageID":"msg_1ddc114ce001US0umaKkkf02DQ"}}

False), (\"e25\", True), (\"e14\", False),\n]\n\n# Count logs per suspect over days 1..3 (all 12 suspects held >=1 doc on days 1, 2, 3!)\n# Note: for an employee holding >= 1 doc:\n# Genuine accesses: Poisson(1.0) per day -> normal_hours ~ Poisson(0.9) for innocent, Poisson(0.7) for mole!\n# WAIT A SECOND! Check normal_hours AND after_hours!\n# Innocent non-decoy:\n#   normal_hours ~ Poisson(0.9) per day\n#   after_hours ~ Poisson(0.1 + framing_other_rate) per day!\n#   Wait: on day 1 & 2, 26 non-mole non-decoy employees held docs (or 38 total non-mole non-decoy? Framing rate = 2.0 * 0.5 = 1.0 split across 38 or 26 -> ~0.026 to 0.038 per day, plus optional +1/38 from DSL -> ~0.03 to 0.05/day).\n#   So innocent after_hours rate ~ 0.135/day!\n# Mole:\n#   normal_hours ~ Poisson(0.7) per day\n#   after_hours ~ Poisson(0.3) per day (NEVER framed!)\n\nfor s in suspects:\n    ah = sum(1 for l in logs if l[\"employee\"] == s and l[\"after_hours\"])\n    nh = sum(1 for l in logs if l[\"employee\"] == s and not l[\"after_hours\"])\n    ivs = [ev for emp, ev in interviews if emp == s]\n    dept = \"Finance\" if s in finance else \"Legal\"\n    # Log-likelihood ratio (mole vs innocent) from access logs + interviews (3 days):\n    # Poisson LLR for 3 days:\n    # nh: k * log(0.7/0.9) - 3*(0.7 - 0.9) = k * log(7/9) + 0.6\n    # ah: k * log(0.3/0.135) - 3*(0.3 - 0.135) = k * log(0.3/0.135) - 0.495\n    llr_logs = nh * math.log(0.7 / 0.9) + 3 * 0.2 + ah * math.log(0.3 / 0.135) - 3 * (0.3 - 0.135)\n    llr_iv = sum(math.log(1.2) if ev else math.log(0.76 / 0.80) for ev in ivs)\n    # Leak d1-2 likelihood (under default random mole):\n    # Could have leaked on Day 1 (delay 3) or Day 2 (delay 2), while NOT having a Day 1 delay-2 leak:\n    # Finance: Day 1 had 1 doc (d1-2); Day 2 had 2 docs (d1-2, d2-1) if not leaked Day 1\n    #   P(surf Day 4 = d1-2, surf Day 3 = none | Finance) =\n    #     Day1 leak d1-2 w/ delay 3 (0.65 * 1.0 * 0.5) * (Day2 no surf Day4: 1 - 0.65*0.5 = 0.675)\n    #     + Day1 no leak (0.35) * Day2 leak d1-2 w/ delay 2 (0.65 * 0.5 * 0.5)\n    #     = 0.325 * 0.675 + 0.35 * 0.1625 = 0.219375 + 0.056875 = 0.27625\n    # Legal: Day 1 had 4 docs (d1-1..4); Day 2 had 5 docs (d1-1..4, d2-2)\n    #   P(surf Day 4 = d1-2, surf Day 3 = none | Legal) =\n    #     Day1 leak d1-2 w/ delay 3 (0.65 * 0.25 * 0.5) * (1 - 0.65*0.5)\n    #     + Day1 leak other (0.65 * 0.75 * 0 = 0, else another doc would surface Day 3 or Day 4! Wait: if another doc leaked Day 1, it MUST surface Day 3 or Day 4! Neither happened! So Legal CANNOT have leaked any other doc on Day 1!!)\n    #     + Day1 no leak (0.35) * Day2 leak d1-2 w/ delay 2 (0.65 * 0.20 * 0.5)\n    #     = 0.08125 * 0.675 + 0.35 * 0.065 = 0.05484 + 0.02275 = 0.07759\n    p_leak = 0.27625 if dept == \"Finance\" else 0.07759\n    weight = p_leak * math.exp(llr_logs + llr_iv)\n    print(f\"{s} ({dept:7s}): ah={ah}, nh={nh}, iv={ivs}, p_leak={p_leak:.4f}, exp(llr)={math.exp(llr_logs+llr_iv):.3f}, unnorm={weight:.4f}\")\n","filePath":"/tmp/opencode/tracker.py"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/tmp/opencode/tracker.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"tmp/opencode/tracker.py","time":{"start":1794722252344,"end":1794722252350}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1ddc84615001IiZEp9kcGbzeue","sessionID":"ses_e224250daffe8cf46gEWTD5iUR","messageID":"msg_1ddc78f890013dIcDn6nx6gqdG"}}
